bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 70
before=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='room' AND data->>'title'='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト'")
test "$before" = 1 || exit 71
rooms=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts WHERE title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours'")
test "$rooms" = 0 || exit 72
deleted=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "WITH target AS (DELETE FROM public_post_drafts d WHERE d.module='room' AND d.data->>'title'='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM room_posts r WHERE r.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id AND r.title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト') RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM target")
test "$deleted" = 1 || exit 73
after=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='room' AND data->>'title'='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト'")
test "$after" = 0 || exit 74
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 75
echo ONLY_STALE_TEST_ROOM_DRAFT_CLEARED=PASS
echo PUBLIC_ROOM_POST_RECORDS_UNCHANGED=PASS
